why: Same mathematics, different packaging of 'the faces of V'. A (proposition_2_42) takes V = dom φ for a tame chart φ : V → O and states the local claims on the model: d_X(y) = d_C(φ y) = d_O(φ y) and the M-polyfold O is face-structured; B uses the induced structure P.subPolyfold hV on the subtype ↥V (its faces and d_V). A ⇒ B needed new glue (~120 lines): an open V is a sub-M-polyfold (r = id) and paracompact (paracompactSpace_subtype); ↥V → X is an sc-diffeomorphism onto V (Prop 2.21 (1),(2) with r = id), so d_V = d_X by Prop 2.24; φ gives a homeomorphism ↥V ≃ₜ ↥O with d_O ∘ φ = d_V, and a degree-respecting homeomorphism maps faces to faces bijectively, so the count at y is d_O(φ y) = d_X(y); the global bound is faces_encard_le. B ⇒ A: faces_encard_le is B's global clause; IsTame.exists_chart is the definition of tameness unpacked (direct); the local clause of proposition_2_42 is about the chart model O, which B's ↥V-statement does not provide, so it is assembled from other items' theorems (tame chart, degIndex_eq_chartDegIndex_of_isTameRetract and degIndex_toMPolyfold_of_isTameWith from V2_42, corollary_2_41 from V2_47) rather than from B.
overlap: 334 shared project theorems: B ⇒ A reuses corollary_2_41 (V2_47) and with it the whole Lemma 2.40 machinery (lemma_2_40, local_face_structure, ray_zeroSet, proposition_2_35, corollary_2_41_retract, isFace_toMPolyfold_iff), Prop. 2.36 (degIndex_eq_chartDegIndex_of_isTameWith, degIndex_toMPolyfold_of_isTameWith), isChart_of_mem_equiv, plus sc-calculus/chart infrastructure — the same lemmas the project's proof of proposition_2_42 uses for its chart-model clause. None of the item's own theorems.
